summary: Prototype Security Rules retain shared meal views and owner/admin writes, add private owner/admin user profiles, administrator-only ordering blocks, and primary-administrator-only role management. Roles are separate from self-written profiles; self/primary lockout and granting roles to anonymous or blocked identities are rejected.
verification: 29 tests passed against the Standard Auth/Firestore emulators, including direct SDK attacks, atomic role-plus-block bypass, private profiles, admin-edit preferred-name regression, committed-order refresh failure, existing account-link and pickup flows. Browser checks covered anonymous order/reload autofill, absent guest admin menu, primary admin grant/block operations and logout cleanup, desktop and 390px layouts. Production Rules have not been published by these tests.

findings.issue: Anonymous identity and per-document validation do not impose a trusted global request-rate limit or prevent repeated anonymous account creation.
findings.recommendation: Monitor usage and assess Firebase App Check or a dedicated rate limit if the app is shared with a broad audience.

attacks.check: Create/update schema bypass, extra fields, missing required fields, numeric ranges and long notes
Forged ownerId, changed ownerId/createdAt, paid status and unit price
Anonymous and Google visitors reading other users' orders and unfiltered order collections
attacks.result: allowed as requested; canEdit false for other owners

attacks.check: Non-owner updates, cancellation, payment changes and deletion via direct SDK or app client
Non-admin listing admin memberships/private profiles/access states or reading another user profile/transfer ticket
attacks.result: blocked; current administrators can read memberships/profiles for management as requested

attacks.check: Self-assigning or editing admin membership, unverified/non-Google admin identities
Changing menu or cutoff as a guest, owner writes after cutoff and invalid day timestamps
Unauthorised/expired ownership transfers, anonymous recipients and transfer combined with payment changes
Orphaned orders/dishes and legacy server collections
Guest ordering/edit/cancel, manager payment, Google account linking and expiring ticket merge
Pickup results created by guests, forged actor/timestamp/week, future date, open/missing day, duplicate keys, extra fields, invalid types and oversize selected names including the last slot
Pickup result overwrite/deletion and replay with a different count
attacks.result: writes blocked; app returns the original result

attacks.check: Concurrent pickup spins and balance for a stable daily group
attacks.result: one official result per date; stable attendance stays within one weekly turn

attacks.check: Profile schema pollution, forged owner/email/provider, oversize name, invalid type, missing required fields, modified createdAt/server timestamps and profile deletion
Regular admin/non-admin role grants, self/primary demotion or lockout, anonymous/unknown/blocked promotion and role/access deletion
Atomic grant-admin plus block in the same batch, blocking an enabled administrator and blocked-user direct order create/update
Primary admin granting/revoking Google roles; administrators block/unblock regular users; blocked owner cancellation before cutoff
Guest preferred name after committed own order, failed refresh and browser storage denial; admin editing someone else
attacks.result: own name retained; storage failure does not prevent ordering; another owner edit does not overwrite admin preference

assumptions: The existing primary admin UID PRIMARY_ADMIN_UID_HERE is bootstrapped in Console; only that enabled verified Google identity may change other administrator memberships in the web app. No self/primary role changes or blocks.
The client normalizes names to NFC and hashes lowercase text; Rules explicitly normalize Vietnamese uppercase Đ for matching browser-generated IDs.

The user explicitly requested shared visibility of all meal information. Rules apply to complete order documents, including notes, owner IDs and payment state; all Firebase visitors, including anonymous customers, can read these. Role documents and ownership-transfer tickets keep their existing private access checks.
Existing mealDays/mealOrders and old signed-cookie guest identities require a separate reviewed migration; this change does not import or expose them.

Pickup results are administrator-created assignments. Rules validate authority, date, roster closure, bounded values and immutability; the trusted admin application computes weekly priority and random tie breaks. History counts selections from feature activation, matched by normalized order name.

User-profile emails/provider are attested by Firebase identity token, readable by owner/admin only. The human explicitly requested a user-management directory for administrators; meal shared-read permissions do not expose these new private profile collections.

Ordering blocks apply to a UID, not Firebase Authentication deletion/disable. Anonymous identities can change after clearing browser data. Historical order owners appear without invented emails; live profiles are registered on later visits.

The deployment tolerates old Rules for optional self-profile sync/own-access reads until manual publication. Required directory and role/block operations still fail closed with a publication message. Browser name storage remains independent of Firebase profile readiness.
